MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 98.79 is moderate. SOFR is secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.455 is a weekly reading for Nov 6, not a live measure.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • Today has scheduled remarks by Governor Michael S. Barr at 5:00 AM ET and Chairman Kevin Warsh at noon ET; the Wednesday Nov 18 FOMC minutes (2:00 PM ET) are not a policy decision. The Nov 18 Treasury 20-year bond auction and Nov 19 TIPS auction are notable duration-supply events.
  • Beyond this week's calendar, the New York Fed lists Q3 GDP second estimate on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM ET; BEA confirms that date. BEA's current schedule places October Personal Income and Outlays on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM ET. The New York Fed Dec calendar lists Employment Situation Dec 4, FOMC decision Dec 9 at 2:00 PM and press conference at 2:30 PM, CPI Dec 10, and PPI Dec 15, all ET. CPI and PPI are distinct releases.
  • Rates/liquidity context: SOFR 3.90% effective Nov 12, NFCI -0.455 for week ending Nov 6, MOVE 98.79 on Nov 13, and official 10-year Treasury close 5.15% on Nov 13. SOFR and NFCI are lagged observations, not live funding measures.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: New York Fed and Census calendars agree on the Nov 17 retail/inventory and Nov 18 construction dates; New York Fed and NAR agree on Nov 18 pending home sales. BEA confirms Q3 GDP second estimate Nov 25 at 8:30 AM. A schedule discrepancy remains outside this week's calendar: the New York Fed Nov calendar lists Personal Income/PCE on Nov 25, while BEA's current schedule places October Personal Income and Outlays on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM; the New York Fed Dec calendar also places PCE on Dec 2 but lists GDP third release there, while BEA dates GDP third estimate to Dec 23. We follow BEA's direct release schedule and flag the New York Fed calendar mismatch rather than listing a duplicate or conflicting event.
  • Selected events, not exhaustive. NY Fed schedule uses BLS dates and times because bls.gov was not requested; no CPI or PPI release is scheduled in the Nov 16-20 week. Periods appear only when stated by the relevant checked source; otherwise marked period not stated. Treasury auction rows show only specifically verified securities; these are competitive-bid close times.
  • Energy schedule check: EIA confirms petroleum's standard Wednesday 10:30 AM release for Nov 18 and natural gas' standard Thursday 10:30 AM release for Nov 19. EIA holiday exceptions are reflected only where listed by the schedule. Treasury auctions and EIA releases are the verified market-structure/energy watch items in this run.
  • Classifier provisional unmatched rows are visibly marked Medium above (including regional indicators, claims, Fed speeches, Census Advance Services, and selected NY Fed indicators); no overrides. No verified unscheduled policy/geopolitical watch item from this run; this is not a full headline-risk review.
  • Primary sources checked: New York Fed November/December economic calendars, Empire State survey, SOFR API; Federal Reserve Board November/December calendars, FOMC calendar and H.4.1; Census; BEA; NAR; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules; TreasuryDirect; Chicago Fed NFCI; U.S. Treasury yield data; University of Michigan. Snapshot uses single-source Yahoo Finance charts with quote times and prior bars shown above.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
ES is below Friday's completed daily bar overnight; SPY's Friday close also fell 0.36%. VIX rose to 19.30, MOVE remains moderate at 98.79, and the 10-year yield advanced to 5.15%. Retail sales and Fed communications are today's/Tuesday's focal points, followed by FOMC minutes, energy releases and Treasury duration supply. Expect event-sensitive two-way risk; monitor rates, breadth and depth rather than reading the thin overnight move as direction. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if retail data or Fed communication materially reprices yields, energy or auction outcomes broaden volatility, or ES price action lacks confirmation from breadth, rates or depth. No unsupported levels or targets supplied. Refresh quotes and verify intended contract specifications before execution.
